title: The 8 Best Cabinet Table Saw 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for cabinet table saw 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at cabinet table saw 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: SawStop PCS31230-TGP252 Professional Cabinet Saw

3 HP motor handles the most demanding hardwood cuts without bogging
52-inch fence for full ripping capacity on wide cabinet panels
The professional standard cabinet saw -- used in the most safety-conscious furniture shops worldwide
